edits.before: Unreal Function Call, Explained 13 Get the subsystem, then ask it for the selection. Expression Meaning unreal.get_editor_subsystem (...) Ask the running editor for a subsystem. unreal.EditorActorSubsystem Class argument: which subsystem we need. editor.get_selected_level_actors () Call on that instance. edits.after: Unreal Subsystems 13 EditorActorSubsystem provides access to level Actors. Expression Meaning unreal.get_editor_subsystem (...) Get the editor subsystem. unreal.EditorActorSubsystem The subsystem class to request. editor.get_selected_level_actors () Return the selected Actors. actors = ... Store the returned Actor array.

edits.before: 01 Unreal Python 14 Unreal: finding the working selection editor: subsystem instance. actor: one selected Actor. Expression Use in an artist tool unreal.get_editor_subsystem(     unreal.EditorActorSubsystem) Get the editor service that manages level Actors. editor.get_selected_level_actors() Read the current Outliner selection. actor.get_actor_label() Show the artist-facing Actor label in a report. actor.get_class().get_name() Report the selected object’s Unreal class.
edits.after: 01 Unreal Python 14 Selected Actors editor is the subsystem. actor is an Actor from its selection. Expression What it does unreal.get_editor_subsystem(     unreal.EditorActorSubsystem) Get the editor service that manages level Actors. editor.get_selected_level_actors() Read the current Outliner selection. actor.get_actor_label() Read the label shown in the Outliner. actor.get_class().get_name() Read the Actor’s class name.

edits.before: 02 Blender to Unreal 50 Blender: inspecting and changing state bpy.ops performs an operation. Its result depends on mode and context. Expression Use in an artist tool obj.location Read local position. Assigning a value moves it. obj.data Read the data block, such as a Mesh. obj.select_set(True) Select this Object in the view layer. bpy.ops.object.transform_apply(     location=False, rotation=True, scale=True) Apply rotation and scale to selected Objects. Requires Object Mode.
edits.after: 02 Blender to Unreal 50 Blender Properties and Operators bpy.ops performs an operation. Its result depends on mode and context. Expression What it does obj.location Read or change local position. obj.data Read the data block, such as a Mesh. obj.select_set(True) Select this Object in the view layer. bpy.ops.object.transform_apply(     location=False, rotation=True, scale=True) Apply rotation and scale in Object Mode.

edits.after: 05 Final Peer Review 102 Final Peer Review Lab Test a classmate’s tool.

edits.before: 05 Final Peer Review 103 Prepare one task a peer can attempt Specify Example User and goal Artist comparing one surface Input and boundary Textures + target; protected crate unchanged Visible success Expected look + correct slot + protected scope Repeat / fallback Reset; labeled walkthrough if blocked Give a goal, not a list of clicks.
edits.after: 05 Final Peer Review 103 Test Setup Specify Example User and goal Artist comparing one surface Input and boundary Textures and target crate, with the other crate unchanged Visible success Material on the intended component and slot Repeat / fallback Reset or use the capture walkthrough Describe the goal without coaching each click.

edits.before: 05 Final Peer Review 104 Three roles, three seven-minute rounds Owner: state the goal. Tester: attempt. Observer: record evidence and help. Round Owner Tester Observer 1 A B C 2 B C A 3 C A B Each tool gets one observed attempt with two peer perspectives.
edits.after: 05 Final Peer Review 104 Peer Review Roles Rotate roles after each seven-minute round. Round Owner Tester Observer 1 A B C 2 B C A 3 C A B Each tool gets one test with two peers.

edits.before: 05 Final Peer Review 105 One round produces evidence and a retest Elapsed Action 0:00–0:45 Owner states task, input and success 0:45–3:45 Tester attempts; observer records 3:45–5:15 Compare expectation with observed result 5:15–6:15 Choose one strength + one revision 6:15–7:00 Write a retest; reset and rotate Blocked? Label the fallback mode and continue.
edits.after: 05 Final Peer Review 105 Seven-Minute Round Elapsed Action 0:00–0:45 Owner states task, input and success 0:45–3:45 Tester works while the observer records 3:45–5:15 Compare expectation with observed result 5:15–6:15 Choose one strength + one revision 6:15–7:00 Write the retest and rotate roles If blocked, continue with a labeled capture walkthrough.

edits.before: 05 Final Peer Review 106 Choose a revision supported by evidence Keep one strength a peer actually observed. Prioritize one issue or uncertainty by its consequence. State the change or investigation you will try. Specify the retest: input, action, expected result and protected scope. What changed or strengthened your original judgment?
edits.after: 05 Final Peer Review 106 Revision Plan Keep one demonstrated strength. Pick the issue that most affects the task. Describe your fix or next investigation. Write a retest with the same input and a clear expected result. What feedback changed your mind?
